body:
a little fashion detective moment for you 👗

two completely different nights: the december 2019 cats world premiere, and march 2021 — the night folklore won album of the year, where she accepted it in a dress covered in floral appliqué.

here's what a lot of people miss: the SAME fashion house made both looks. one designer, two eras, two totally different moods.

can you name it before you peek? our runway thread has the receipts — designer, date, every gown in order.

take a guess, then go check 👉 https://longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
altText: Fan photo from the Eras Tour, shared on r/TaylorSwiftPictures: Taylor Swift Looking Beautiful
why: Runway thread hero / October make-good (calendar 10-30, protected). quiz-poll angle: a designer re-wear only the lens surfaces — Oscar de la Renta dressed Taylor at both the 2019 Cats premiere (look-lover-cats-premiere) and the folklore AOTY Grammys (look-folklore-grammys-red-carpet). IG asks in prose + sends to the lens; X poses it tersely. Photo-only (no rich lens screenshot to commit this run).

critique.rationale: Executes the protected Runway make-good with the quiz-poll angle: a real cross-era designer re-wear (Oscar de la Renta, Cats 2019 + folklore Grammys 2021) that only someone who opened the lens could answer. Fan voice, dated and checkable. Photo is a real but generic Taylor shot, so media is a 3.
